title: Last breakfast, last Donki, fly home

stops.name: Check out Garfield House
stops.plan: Out well before the 10:00 deadline; everyone holds their own passport and a carry-on with ALL tax-free goods and receipts (big suitcases go to Haneda by Yamato if sent on Dec 27, otherwise they roll along).
stops.transport: Walk about 20 min west through Shinjuku Station, or Toei Shinjuku line Shinjuku-sanchome → Shinjuku (1 stop, ¥180), about 27 min door to door

stops.name: Shinpachi Shokudo Nishi-Shinjuku
stops.plan: Last Japanese breakfast of grilled-fish teishoku sets; the chain is confirmed open from 07:00 on 29 Dec, and 8 split across 2–3 tables.
stops.transport: Walk 13 min east through Shinjuku Station to Isetan

stops.name: Isetan Shinjuku depachika
stops.plan: Boxed sweets and omiyage from the food hall, packed with year-end shoppers, so split up and meet at the main entrance at 11:20; grab an onigiri to tide you over to the late lunch.

stops.name: Don Quijote Shinjuku Kabukicho
stops.plan: Final snack, cosmetics and gift haul (open 24h); pay with your own passport, keep ≥¥5,000 ex-tax on one receipt and leave it unopened in your carry-on. Hard stop at 12:45.
stops.transport: About 60 min door to door: walk to Shinjuku, Marunouchi line → Akasaka-mitsuke, Ginza line → Shimbashi, JR Yamanote → Hamamatsucho, Tokyo Monorail Airport Rapid → Haneda Airport Terminal 3, arriving 13:47 (¥890, IC card); fewer changes: JR Yamanote Shinjuku → Shinagawa, then Keikyu Airport line to Haneda T3

stops.name: Tax-free refund customs kiosk (Haneda T3)
stops.plan: BEFORE bag drop: each person scans their passport at the customs tax-free kiosk in the departures lobby with every refundable item in hand; one missing item voids that whole receipt.
stops.transport: Walk 1 min to the airline counters

stops.name: Bag drop at the airline counter (T3 departures)
stops.plan: Collect any Yamato-delivered suitcases first, then check in and drop bags only after the kiosk shows green.
stops.transport: Escalator up to Edo Koji (4F), 1 min

stops.name: Haneda T3 Edo Market Place (Edo Koji)
stops.plan: Last ramen, sushi or soba before security in the Edo-style street; split across shops and regroup at 15:40 sharp.
stops.transport: Walk 1 min to the security entrance

stops.name: Security and passport control (T3)
stops.plan: Peak year-end departure day: allow a full hour for security and immigration, then straight to the gate.

stops.name: Flight departs Haneda T3
stops.plan: Wheels up at 17:20; boarding usually starts about 30 min before.
